# Medico Scientific Service Centre

> Medico Scientific Service Centre is a Srinagar-based supplier and authorised service centre
> for clinical-grade medical equipment, serving hospitals, clinics, and families across
> Jammu & Kashmir since 2000. Founded by Mr. Syed Naseer Ahmad Andrabi. GST registered
> (01AALPI4731K1ZV). Authorised distributor for Philips (respiratory/sleep therapy),
> Schiller (diagnostics), and Shalya (surgical equipment).

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://medico-inky.vercel.app/): Company overview, product categories, customer testimonials, contact
- [Products / Equipment Catalog](https://medico-inky.vercel.app/shop.html): Full catalog — Oxygen Dynamics, Anaesthesia, Diagnostics, Emergency & Resuscitation, Critical Care, Sleep & NIV, Surgery
- [About Us](https://medico-inky.vercel.app/about.html): Company history (est. 2000), founder Mr. Syed Naseer Ahmad Andrabi, brand partnerships, physical address, certifications
- [Blog & Insights](https://medico-inky.vercel.app/blog.html): Medical equipment guidance and healthcare updates for Jammu & Kashmir

## Product Categories

- Oxygen Dynamics (concentrators, portable delivery systems)
- Anaesthesia (workstations, gas delivery)
- Diagnostics (patient monitoring, telemetry)
- Emergency & Resuscitation (defibrillators, AEDs)
- Critical Care (multiparameter monitors, ventilators)
- Sleep & NIV (CPAP, BiPAP, APAP machines)
- Surgery (laparoscopic, electrosurgical instruments)

## Services

- Equipment supply and installation
- Staff training and clinical orientation
- Preventive maintenance and AMC
- Repair and calibration
- 7-days-a-week technical support
